role_summary: Lead a global team responsible for managing cloud infrastructure for enterprise SaaS solutions across Asia, Europe, and the US, ensuring compliance with security, stability, and performance requirements, while driving continuous improvements and managing IT operations.
must_have_requirements: 15+ years of hands-on experience in IT infrastructure
8+ years in a leadership or team lead role
Bachelor degree in Information Technology or related field
Solid experience in public clouds including AWS and Azure
Experience managing cloud networking, NGINX, Kubernetes, Java applications, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Redis/Valkey, RabbitMQ/Azure Service Bus, AWS S3/Azure Blob Storage
Good communication and stakeholder management skills
Fluent in English and Chinese (Cantonese and Putonghua)
Eligible to work in Hong Kong without sponsorship
nice_to_have_requirements: Experience with other public clouds like GCP
DevOps practices, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and tools such as Jenkins

scoring_criteria.name: Cloud Platform Expertise (AWS & Azure)
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core requirement for managing infrastructure in public clouds; must have deep hands-on experience.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Specific services (EC2, S3, VPC, Azure Blob)
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Ensure depth in at least one cloud and breadth in the other

scoring_criteria.name: Leadership & Team Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must lead a global, distributed team across multiple regions with 8+ years leadership experience.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Demonstrate ability to manage across time zones

scoring_criteria.name: Infrastructure Technology Stack
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: JD lists specific technologies that are critical for the platform; hands-on experience required.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Each listed tech mentioned in resume
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Prioritize breadth; need proficiency in most, with depth in some

scoring_criteria.name: DevOps & Automation Practices
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Continuous improvement and operations automation are key responsibilities; CI/CD and IaC are desirable.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Good to have; not mandatory but strongly preferred

scoring_criteria.name: Compliance & Security Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Support SOC 2 Type 2 audits and ensure security/stability; requires understanding of security frameworks.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Must show ability to work with auditors and implement security controls

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder & Vendor Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Collaborate with product/application teams and manage IT vendors to align with goals.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Show specific examples of vendor assessment and alignment

scoring_criteria.name: Communication & Language Skills
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must be fluent in English and Chinese (Cantonese and Putonghua) to work with teams in HK, China, Europe, US.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Fluent in both required; only English is a gap

scoring_criteria.name: Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Drive improvements in infrastructure design, cost optimization, and operations automation.

scoring_criteria.name: Education & Certifications
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Bachelor degree in IT-related field required; certifications desirable but not must.

do_not_overclaim: Do not claim AWS/Azure expertise if only basic exposure—need depth
Do not list technologies you haven't actually worked with
Do not exaggerate leadership experience if team size was small
Do not claim fluency in Cantonese if not truly fluent

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Highlight extensive hands-on cloud infrastructure leadership with a track record of managing complex, multi-region SaaS environments. Emphasize ability to lead diverse, distributed teams and drive compliance and automation.
bridge_gaps_honestly: If missing certifications, emphasize years of equivalent experience
If not fluent in Cantonese, highlight fluency in Putonghua and English and commitment to learn
If lacking specific tech like Valkey, mention similar technologies and ability to learn quickly
